title: Watercolor 62 Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per Watercolor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 6 bands to access Watercolor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Forest community of WaterColor- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- Community pool- 3 adult bikes provided- Pet friendly- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: 62 Royal Fern Way is a 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home that sleeps 6. Conveniently tucked away in WaterColor’s Forest District. With driveway parking for 2 vehicles and a screened-in porch off the kitchen, grocery shopping and exploring 30A is a breeze.Up the steps to the front porch, guests are welcomed to a bright and airy living room with a guest bedroom with 2 twin beds on the left. From the living room past the breakfast bar, the combination kitchen and dining area open to the screened-in porch at the rear of the home, providing easy driveway access and a comfortable outdoor lounge. The second guest bedroom has a queen bed, while guests staying in the primary bedroom will enjoy a king bed and direct access to the screened-in porch.With 3 adult bikes, it's easy to explore WaterColor's many amenities. Guests enjoy access to the WaterColor Beach Club or utilize the public beach access off County Highway 395. Call Callista by 360 Blue today to schedule your WaterColor getaway.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400 plus tax.*Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
